identification: Two pale, nearly white-yellow live-edge slabs, long and narrow, with bark inclusions, knots and voids, chalked 1113 23/10/26. Colour is more like celery top pine or similar pale timber than golden Huon pine, though Gowans sells this whole run of chalked slabs under the Huon pine title. Part of a long series of near-identical lots (1112, 1114 beside it).

searches_tried: work/comps.py and pipeline/comps.py (huon pine slab, huon pine, slab timber, celery top pine); Gowans API search '2 slabs of huon pine' (about 100 sold lots listed). No web search: this is a repeating generic Gowans series with a deep same-venue, same-buyer-pool sample, so retail Huon pine prices (sawn, kiln-dried, graded) are not a useful guide to raw chalked slabs. eBay sold would not add much. Aud only, no FX.
viewing_check: Check the grain and smell: genuine Huon pine is golden with very fine tight grain and a strong sweet oil smell; these look pale and plain, so likely celery top or similar. Check thickness, length and that the slabs are sound (no splits or rot at voids). Nothing else would change the value much.
rate_note: All AUD, no conversion. Hammer prices exclude the 19.8% premium.
